issues: Uses native HTML <select> instead of shadcn Select — inconsistent with rest-of-app UX. Triggers a React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (the project rows use spans inside options). Functional but should switch to shadcn Select.
Uses native window.prompt() for override_reason (same pattern as Phase 4 Control Center transition). Consider shadcn AlertDialog + textarea for one-step confirmation (already flagged in iter103).

rca of the issue: CRITICAL bug found: main agent registered <Route ... element={<ProjectClosureCenter />}> in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 198 but forgot to add the corresponding `import ProjectClosureCenter from '@/pages/ops/ProjectClosureCenter'` statement near line 126 (where other ops/ pages are imported). React threw 'ReferenceError: ProjectClosureCenter is not defined' at App-component render, which propagated to crash every single route in the app (not just /app/ops/closure-center). Reproduction: navigate to any /app/* route → red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. Fix applied by testing agent: inserted the import at line 127, alongside other ops/ imports. Verified by re-running full Playwright flow — all routes render normally and Closure Center loads with all 6 tabs working.
